name: VrockAddons for Elementor
author: Awal Bashar

sections.description:
VrockAddons for Elementor – Elevate Your Website with Advanced Custom Widgets!

Boost your Elementor experience with VrockAddons, an essential addon packed with versatile and fully customizable widgets. Designed for developers, designers, and business owners alike, VrockAddons makes it easy to build eye-catching, dynamic websites — all without writing a single line of code.

Lightweight & Fast Loading

Enjoy instant page loads and real-time editing — no bloat, no slowdowns, just seamless performance every time.

🔥 Key Features:
✔ Exclusive Custom Widgets – Access unique widgets not available in default Elementor.
✔ Easy Drag & Drop – Seamlessly integrate widgets into your pages with Elementor’s intuitive builder.
✔ Fully Responsive – Ensure your designs look perfect on all devices.
✔ Lightweight & Optimized – Built for speed without compromising functionality.
✔ Regular Updates – Get new widgets and improvements frequently.

Expert Support

Beginner-Friendly – Simple for newcomers, flexible for experts.

sections.installation:
Note : This plugin works with Elementor. Make sure you have Elementor installed.

  1. install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. All available elements are accessible within the Elementor editor interface.
  4. All these elements are organized under the ‘VrockAddons’ category in your Elementor widget panel for easy access.
sections.faq:
Can I use VrockAddons without Elementor?

No. VrockAddons is built as an extension for Elementor, so you’ll need Elementor installed for it to work. It cannot function as a standalone plugin.

Is it compatible with all themes?

Yes! VrockAddons works seamlessly with any theme that supports Elementor.

Do I need Elementor Pro to use this?

Not at all. VrockAddons is fully compatible with the free version of Elementor — Elementor Pro is optional.
